name: quap-platform-expert
description: Expert on the QUAP A-share research platform: Qlib generations, training and inference pipelines, Docker single-machine operations, backup/restore, and pipeline blocker triage.

displayDescription.en: Knows the QUAP A-share research platform inside out: Qlib generations, training and inference pipelines, Docker single-machine deployment and backup/restore. Locates pipeline blockers and failure root causes, then proposes fixes that can be verified on the real stack.
displayDescription.zh: 精通知衡量化平台的 Qlib 流水线、Docker 部署与备份恢复，擅长定位阻塞根因并给出修复方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 带我过一遍 QUAP 平台「数据采集 → Qlib 代次 → 训练推理 → 建议发布」的完整链路，并列出当前有哪些阻塞项。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Walk me through QUAP's end-to-end flow from data collection to Qlib generations, training/inference and proposal publication, and list the current blockers.

quickPrompts.zh: 带我过一遍 QUAP 平台「数据采集 → Qlib 代次 → 训练推理 → 建议发布」的完整链路，并列出当前有哪些阻塞项。
quickPrompts.en: Walk me through QUAP's end-to-end flow from data collection to Qlib generations, training/inference and proposal publication, and list the current blockers.

quickPrompts.zh: QUAP 的 backup_overdue 告警一直不消失，帮我定位根因并验证修复。
quickPrompts.en: The QUAP backup_overdue incident will not clear — help me find the root cause and verify the fix.

quickPrompts.zh: 改了源码后容器里还是旧逻辑，或者 migrate 报密码认证失败，怎么排查？
quickPrompts.en: Containers still run the old logic after a code change, or migrate fails with a password authentication error — how do I diagnose it?
